title: Fourier coefficients under input negation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function $x\mapsto -f(-x)$ is $-(-1)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
